wu_bu_mapping.hamilton_encoder: Maps tower iteration to Hamilton quaternions -> nested Poincaré spheres
wu_bu_mapping.wubu_nesting: Right-associative iteration = nesting depth 4 in WuBu hierarchy
wu_bu_mapping.poincare_spheres: E/H spheres at each level correspond to π, π^π, π^π^π, π^π^π^π
wu_bu_mapping.topological_charge: Radii parametrized by ℓ = 1,2,3,4 -> Chern numbers give integer invariants
wu_bu_mapping.hopf_fibration: S³ → S² for structured point cloud sampling on each sphere
wu_bu_mapping.mlp_v_encoder: Retrain for tower-specific log-space mapping: ln(π), π ln π, etc.
wu_bu_mapping.bytropix_dual_head: Head 1: geometric map (sphere params), Head 2: invariant (intersection number)

implementation_steps.title: Tower-to-Manifold Map
implementation_steps.details: Implement f: [π, π^π, π^π^π, π^π^π^π] -> M where M = iterated S² bundle. Use exponential map on su(2): π -> S²(π), then iterate.

implementation_steps.title: Poincaré Sphere Sampling (Hopf)
implementation_steps.details: Sample points on S² via Hopf fibration: S³ → S². Use quaternion representation for structured sampling. Preserve topological charge ℓ.

implementation_steps.title: Integer Invariant Definition
implementation_steps.details: Define intersection number I = ∫_M ω_1 ∧ ω_2 ∧ ω_3 ∧ ω_4 where ω_i are curvature forms on each sphere. Chern number gives integer invariant. If I = 0 -> N not integer.

implementation_steps.title: Point-Cloud Fractional Part Estimator
implementation_steps.details: Monte Carlo integration of fractional part {log N} = {log log log log N}. Sample point clouds on spheres, compute invariant statistics. Cluster near integer -> N integer.

implementation_steps.title: RTX 4050 Monte Carlo Run
implementation_steps.details: Run 10^6 samples on RTX 4050 (6GB VRAM, -ngl 20). Use int8 precision. Batch size 256. Expected ~30 min.

implementation_steps.title: Seymour Ponderable Entry
implementation_steps.details: Format results as Ponderable: allegory = tower ascent, clipart = nested spheres, commentary = invariant calculation.

precision_strategy.log_space: Work in log space: ln(π) ~ 1.1447, π ln π ~ 3.5966, etc. Avoid direct exponentiation.
precision_strategy.int8_quantization: Use bytropix int8 quantization for curvature forms and sampling.
precision_strategy.kahan_summation: For Monte Carlo accumulation to reduce floating error.
precision_strategy.mpfr_validation: Cross-check key values with MPFR arbitrary precision for calibration.
